Telkom, a major phone and internet provider partly owned by South Africa’s government, has urged telecom regulator ICASA to make its empowerment rules more flexible.

• Current rules require individual telecoms licensees to maintain at least 30% ownership by historically disadvantaged groups, a hurdle for Starlink’s entry.

• Any changes should apply equally to existing providers and newcomers, including Starlink.
